title: Contact
body:
The quickest way to reach NEXTDROP is by message. We reply to all order and product questions there.

- **WhatsApp:** use the button below or message +44 7947 942458
- **Telegram:** use the button below
- **Instagram:** [[TO COMPLETE: add your Instagram handle, or remove this line]]
- **Email:** [[TO COMPLETE: add a contact email, or remove this line]]

**Message hours:** [[TO COMPLETE: e.g. Monday to Saturday, 10am–8pm]]

When asking about a product, please include the product reference (for example ND001) so we can help you faster.
